# source: KOMA-Script manual ch. 5 (scrlayer-scrpage) — the \ihead/\chead/\ohead
# and foot triplets, the one-sided/two-sided variants, \clearpairofpagestyles,
# \pagestyle{scrheadings}; \setkomafont/\addtokomafont from ch. 4. The starred
# \cfoot* breaks declaration scanning (E0313, the star-scan defect).
pre impl \ihead{x}
pre impl \chead{x}
pre impl \ohead{x}
pre impl \ifoot{x}
pre refuse:E0313 \cfoot*{x}
pre impl \ofoot{x}
pre refuse:W0301 \lohead{x}
pre refuse:W0301 \rehead{x}
pre inert:default \clearpairofpagestyles
pre inert:noop \pagestyle{scrheadings}
pre impl \setkomafont{section}{\bfseries}
pre impl \setkomafont{disposition}{\bfseries}
pre refuse:W0301 \addtokomafont{section}{\itshape}
# Two rows move no ink and say why: \clearpairofpagestyles clears to the
# state a document starts in (no running fields), and \pagestyle{scrheadings}
# is answered by nothing — declared fields apply by themselves. The field
# rows above carry the drawn evidence.
